priorityPhilosophy.description: Hierarchy of what matters most when implementing tasks
hierarchy: 1. PLAN — Anticipate edge cases before coding
2. PHASE 2 FOUNDATION — ~1 day now to save ~2+ weeks later (1:10+ ratio); we are pre-launch, foundations compound
3. FUNCTIONING CODE — Pragmatic, reliable, wired in per plan
4. CORRECTNESS — Compiles, type-checks, scoped tests pass deterministically
5. CODE QUALITY — Clean code, qualityDimensions satisfied, no warnings
principles: Quality dimensions explicit — qualityDimensions on every task tells you what 'good' looks like
Phase 2 foundation — path identity + prd_json chokepoint are the substrate for PR-2 update and PR-3 export; do not invent a second writer or a discovery remapper
Edge cases = test cases — every PR-1 known edge case must have a corresponding test
Scoped per-iteration tests, full suite at REVIEW-001 — REVIEW must leave the trunk green including pre-existing failures
Pins 1–4 / 11–16 / 19–21 are law; pins 5–10 / 17–18 must not be implemented or contradicted
Ship working code with tests to prove it; handle Option/Result explicitly; avoid unwrap() in production

acceptanceCriteria: Precise interface: `git::worktree_root_at(dir: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf>` and `git::worktree_root() -> Option<PathBuf>` mirror `main_repo_root_at` / `main_repo_root` (`git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, canonicalized like `main_repo_root_at`); `git::remap_into_worktree(registered: &Path, source_root: &Path, worktree_root: &Path) -> PathBuf` is infallible path math; pin-19 identity in `context` is (b)+(c) only — `canonicalize(flag) == canonicalize(resolved)` OR `canonicalize(flag) == remap_into_worktree(...)` after joining relative `registered` to `source_root`

Edge cases: dest missing still remaps (no dest canonicalize); main checkout (`worktree_root == source_root`) returns joined registered path; relative registered joined before remap; symlink `source_root` vs canonical `prd_file` (caller canonicalizes `source_root`, helper does not canonicalize dest); strip_prefix miss returns `resolved` unchanged; identity tests seed `prd_files` as init would (`tasks/foo.json` or absolute)

Invariants: helper has no `exists()`, no basename search, no directory walk, no dest canonicalize, no fs side effects; loop Step 8.5 keeps canonicalize-`source_root` then calls the helper; CLI existence is a different caller-side function never imported by startup; match (a) (`JSON taskPrefix` in `prd_metadata`) is NOT this function

Known-bad discriminators: (1) putting `exists()` inside the helper so a missing dest returns the main path — naive 'round-trip when dest exists' tests pass, dest-missing unit fails; (2) treating pin-19 as including match (a) so a stray same-prefix copy is 'the' identity — path identity must stay (b)+(c); (3) seeding identity tests with a bare basename `foo.json` when init stores `tasks/foo.json`

Failure modes: `worktree_root_at` returns None outside a repo / git missing (same class as `main_repo_root_at`); remap is infallible even when dest does not exist; canonicalize of the flag path may io-err (caller of identity, not the helper)

Alternatives considered: rejected 'one resolve-live-JSON helper with exists() inside' (pin 15 — startup would stop remapping a missing dest); rejected basename/discovery search (pin 14 / learning #2236)

Downstream impact: FEAT-001 (implement remapper + startup call), FEAT-004 (relative+worktree `--from-json` registration), FEAT-004b (default write path), FEAT-005 (`current` target= + live worktree matrix); later PR-2 update / PR-3 export overwrite-guard (do not implement)
